title: A note left in a stone cairn… the last message 📜 #FranklinExpedition
subtitle: Frozen Passage · Short 1/6
caption:
May 1859, King William Island. Searchers find a cairn – and inside a metal cylinder, the last message of the lost Franklin Expedition. The ships abandoned. The commander dead. 105 men on foot across the ice.

▶ Full documentary on the channel: Frozen Passage – The Lost Franklin Expedition
